findings.title: odin test app/input segfaults at head: input.draw_drag_on_a_node_never_pans (base green) — new unguarded Input.state deref

findings.detail: The PR added Input.state and routed draw/place commit fast paths through box_apply_edit, which derefs state.box_enabled unguarded; the pre-existing camera fixture never sets state -> nil deref. Verified: 13/13 green at 03dd6f8, SIGSEGV at ad8afca. The gate table's 'odin test app 51/51' does not run the app/input subpackage suite, masking the regression.
findings.recommended_fix: Wire ictx.state = st in cam_test_ctx (or nil-guard the fast paths), fix the offending path, and add 'odin test app/input' to the gate table.

findings.title: Box refusal on the placement path is silent — the Era-3-critical 'no' never teaches (5-lens agreement)

findings.title: Pre-commit surfaces (R3 route preview, placement ghost) validate topology only — players plan into refusals they can't see or hear

findings.detail: The preview blesses draws/placements the Box will refuse; combined with the silent place refusal the player gets zero pre-commit and zero at-commit feedback. Render file itself unchanged — the gap is economic semantics the preview never learned.
findings.recommended_fix: Feed box_validate (or a cheap affordability predicate) into the preview/ghost validity check.

findings.title: crisis-stall scenario never injects a crisis — record Q7's death-spiral seam is named, not tested
findings.location: harness/econ.odin:358-361 (econ_run_scenario seed 7 only; no crisis injection in econ.odin)
findings.detail: The scenario is a different-seed era-3 run; no crisis ever fires, so the crisis->slower-dots delivery collapse — the exact Q7 interaction the record demands a sim run for — is untested. The interval-in-[floor,base] assertion is trivially held by the production clamp.
findings.recommended_fix: Inject a crisis (or a delivery-drought shape) into the scenario so deliveries actually stall mid-run; assert the floor holds across the collapse.

findings.title: stats_destroy never frees rec.box.pieces — one leaked dynamic array per tick on box-on stats runs
findings.location: core/stats.odin:195 (make per record) vs :378-384 (destroy frees classes/pipes/ports/drops only)
findings.detail: stats_compute allocates rec.box.pieces per emitted record when box_enabled; destroy omits it. The app emits per step at 20 Hz, so box-on sessions grow the leak continuously; harness runs leak per-tick too (the 17.5KiB leak notices in odin test core output are this surfacing).
findings.recommended_fix: delete(rec.box.pieces) in stats_destroy before rec^ = {}.
